name: Unifi-network-application
description: The Unifi-network-application software is a powerful, enterprise wireless software engine ideal for high-density client deployments requiring low latency and high uptime performance.
short_desc: The Unifi-network-application software is a powerful, enterprise wireless software engine ideal for high-density client
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: MONGO_USER
form_fields.hint: Mongodb Username. Only evaluated on first run. Special characters must be url encoded.

form_fields.label: MONGO_PASS
form_fields.hint: Mongodb Password. Only evaluated on first run. Special characters must be url encoded.

form_fields.label: MONGO_HOST
form_fields.hint: Mongodb Hostname. Only evaluated on first run.

form_fields.label: MONGO_PORT
form_fields.hint: Mongodb Port. Only evaluated on first run.

form_fields.label: MONGO_DBNAME
form_fields.hint: Mongodb Database Name (stats DB is automatically suffixed with stat). Only evaluated on first run.

form_fields.label: MONGO_AUTHSOURCE
form_fields.hint: Mongodb authSource. For Atlas set to admin. Only evaluated on first run.

form_fields.label: MEM_LIMIT
form_fields.hint: Optionally change the Java memory limit (in Megabytes). Set to default to reset to default

form_fields.label: MEM_STARTUP
form_fields.hint: Optionally change the Java initial/minimum memory (in Megabytes). Set to default to reset to default

form_fields.label: MONGO_TLS
form_fields.hint: Mongodb enable TLS. Only evaluated on first run.
